identity.title: List of English language Master Quest home video releases (Region 1)

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifth season of , Master Quest, in and ( ).

In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to VIZ Media season (which correspond to opening themes), rather than by standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifth season of , Master Quest, in and ( ).

In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to VIZ Media season (which correspond to opening themes), rather than by standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com).

==Box sets==
Two Master Quest DVD box sets were released by Viz Video and Ventura Distribution between 2004-2005, containing the whole season between them. There are two boxed sets each containing three DVD cases with one disc each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Quest 1: Episodes 1-32===
 
Pokémon: Master Quest - Quest 1 was released by VIZ Media on October 26, 2004. It contains three discs with 32 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMQBS1.

 

===Quest 2: Episodes 33-64===
 
Pokémon: Master Quest - Quest 2 was released by VIZ Media on February 15, 2005. It contains three discs with 32 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMQBS2.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon - Master Quest: The Complete Collection was released on October 11, 2016 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains seven discs with 64 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000068037. This release consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. Optional English closed captioning is included.

This release features the versions of episodes without the broadcast edits, in contrast to the first US home video release which does feature the censorship such as the edits in EP245 and EP247.
